body:
Previous week seemed to be long and quite stressful and a little sleep-deprived. So had going to sleep by 8pm. on Friday. Saturday afternoon still was extremely sleepy for me. As I had a biology student at 2 p.m, having woken up at 1p.m. I felt like using something to get my alertness back.  I decided to give some amphetamine a try (around 40mg, intranasal). 30 min after   the insufflation I thought I felt some physical and mood effect,  my teaching became a bit more easygoing,  smoothing  faster. But absolutely not as good as I wanted too. So, by the end of the hour, I downed a solution of green malay kratom, supposingly the activating strain of one...Though I hated the bitter-bit taste,  this worked the best for me on weekends especially.
But! Not this time. Only 20 minutes past,  I started feeling stronger relaxation and extremely sleepy and dizzy,  barely finished the lesson and as soon as the student left, I crashed into a deep 4hour sleep. After waking up the effects seem to have complete worn off, only slight dizziness remains. Never heard of such interactions before.
